searchText: I'm still not convinced we have a good enough standard to reduce slashing risk. A user, by accident, uses his seed on tesnet and mainnet will get himself slashed with 100% probability (signing at slot X on testnet and then on slot X on mainnet). I think because of how sensitive it is we might need to consider having different derivation paths. This is not correct. The signature domain will be different.
